title: OpenClaw vs Make.com: When AI Agents Beat Workflow Automation
summary: Make.com is the most powerful workflow automation tool. OpenClaw is an AI agent that thinks, not just triggers. Here's when each wins — and when you need both.
body_markdown: Make switched from "operations" to "credits" in August 2025. For standard workflows, 1 module execution = 1 credit — nothing changed in practice. The difference emerges with AI modules: Make's native AI features now charge variable credits based on token usage (1,500–5,000 tokens per credit depending on model size). Polling triggers also drain credits even when no new data arrives. For AI-heavy workflows, cost planning matters.
